transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Good morning, Lily. Welcome to International School Bangkok. Please, come in.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: Thank you. It's great to be here.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: We like to start with a handshake. A good first impression matters.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: I agree. I make eye contact and smile when I meet someone new.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Tell me about yourself. What are your best skills?

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: My best skill is communication. I listen well, and I enjoy talking to new people.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: That's important. What about teamwork?

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: I'm a real team player. I like helping my group stay calm and focused.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Are you a natural leader?

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: Sometimes. I stay calm under pressure, so people trust me with decisions.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Have you ever had to be decisive in a difficult moment?

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: Yes. Last year, our school play lost its director. I came up with a new plan, and we acted out all the scenes in one week.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Wonderful. Did you ever want to give up?

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: No. Some friends dropped out of the play, but I faced up to the challenge. Hard work pays off.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: What do you want to work on?

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: My time management. I sometimes leave big tasks to the last minute.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Patience helps. Good time management is a skill you can learn.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: Thank you. I really hope I get a place at your school.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: You made a lasting impression today, Lily. We'll be in touch soon.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you.
